annotations.title: Change a map (safe changes apply, others wait for review)

description:
Changes an EXISTING mind map, kanban or BOARD (also one in a team space). ON A BOARD, target elements by the ids read_map shows (sh:2, im:7, st:0), or an image by its exact name: add_image { file | url | data, name, alt, x, y, w, h } or { ..., inside: "sh:2" } — placed below what that shape already holds, in centred rows, never overlapping, on top of the shape; with both w and h the image is FITTED into that cell with its proportions kept; add_shape { type, x, y, w, h, text, color }, add_text { x, y, text }, move { target, x, y } or { target, dx, dy }, resize { target, w, h }, label { target, name, alt } to name an existing image, arrange { target: "sh:2", images: [ids or names], w, h } to line images up inside a shape (omit images to tidy all it holds), and delete { target }. All but delete are applied by TabTree itself; delete waits for review. Sending the same add twice never makes a duplicate: images are matched by name, which defaults to the file's name. On a mind map or kanban, HYBRID, by design: SAFE changes — add cards or branches, move a card to a column, tick it, set its owner, dates, priority, labels, estimate, Ai4X lever, an attribute, a link, a comment, a picture, a ⭐ star for the user, the map's format, the running sprint's goal when none is typed yet (op season), and set up the columns of a board that has none — are APPLIED BY TABTREE ITSELF within seconds when TabTree is open on one of the user's devices (otherwise the next time it opens), and Cmd+Z undoes them. Changes that rewrite or remove what someone wrote — rename, note, delete, replacing existing columns, replacing a sprint goal someone typed, a persona re-cast — appear as a banner for the user to review and approve. In one call, the safe changes BEFORE the first review-only change apply by themselves and the rest goes to review, in order. Name each target node by its exact text, or by a path "Ancestor > Node" when the same wording appears twice; a later change may target a node added earlier in the same call. Read the map first so the wording matches.

STEERING A 🗂 PROJECT (format projet) — no extra tool, four safe changes: (1) read_map and use its “🗂 Project” block — the live sprint's counts and the Backlog ranked by ICE = Impact × Confidence × (6 − Effort), from the cards' (or their epic's) `Impact:` / `Confidence:` / `Effort:` attributes; (2) plan the next sprint by pulling the top of that ranking from Backlog into “To do” with `move` — keep the work-in-progress to about 6 committed cards in total (committed = everything off Backlog), fewer if some are still Doing; (3) set the running sprint's goal with { op: "season", goal: "…", name: "Sprint 2" } — it lands in the 🎯 chip and the 🏁 panel, by itself when nobody typed one, for review otherwise (set "Sprint length" / "Sprints start" once on the ROOT with `attr`); (4) settle a bet with { op: "attr", target: "<epic text>", name: "Verdict", value: "validated" } — untested, testing, validated or invalidated. Give each change a `why`. Add a new epic with `add` under “🧱 Epics” (its four attribute lines and its cards in one markdown), a decision with `add` under “📝 Decisions”, and turn an existing map into a project with { op: "format", format: "projet" }. The user closes a sprint in TabTree's 🏁 panel; the connector never closes one. PLACING A KANBAN CARD ON THE FREE BOARD: place { target, x, y } puts a card where the user's 🎨 Board view draws it (x, y = its top-left corner); a shape there named after a column, a day or a person is a zone, and TabTree writes that field itself — the move / due / assign the zone implies are added to your proposal. read_map lists the zones. A person zone is recognised only from an assign already on the map, or Claude. A batch that contradicts its own zone is refused.

changes.description: The proposed changes, applied in order

alt.description: add_image, label: what the image shows, in one line — read_map returns it

assign.description: assign: a name or e-mail ("" clears it). add: optional — the owner of the NEW cards. When read_map shows a 👥 Team, pick from it, by role, what each person owns and their objectives

col.description: add_image with inside: optional grid column, from 0. move: the kanban column — its NAME ("Doing") or id, both shown by read_map — or "" to take the card off the board. add: optional — the column the NEW cards go to

color.description: add_shape, add_text: a hex colour, e.g. #dbeafe

columns.description: columns: the board's columns left to right — [{ name, done?, wip? }]; mark ONE done:true. Existing columns keep their cards when their name is kept

data.description: img, add_image: a data:image/…;base64 URL instead of `file`

due.description: due: the due day as YYYY-MM-DD ("" removes it)

dx.description: move: by how much, horizontally, instead of x

dy.description: move: by how much, vertically, instead of y

est.description: est: the estimate as a duration — "2h", "1h30", "45" (minutes), "2:15" — or "" to remove it

file.description: img: full path of the screenshot (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF) on this machine. It is re-encoded to about 840 px and becomes the node's cover picture. add_image: full path of the picture (SVG too).

format.description: format: the map's living format — projet, okr, pv, org, radial, tree, outline, oneside, timeline, suivi — or "" for a plain mind map

gap.description: add_image with inside, arrange: the space between images (24 by default)

goal.description: season: the running sprint's goal — one sentence, 200 characters max ("" clears it)

images.description: arrange: the images to line up, by id (im:7) or name; they go below what the shape already holds. Omit to tidy every image inside the shape

img.description: img: pass "" to REMOVE the screenshot from that node (otherwise give `file` or `data`)

inside.description: add_image: the shape to put it in (sh:2). Without x and y it is laid out below what the shape holds, never overlapping

lever.description: lever: human, think, accelerate or automate ("" removes it)

link.description: link: an https:// or mailto: address, or map:<file> to open another map ("" removes it)

markdown.description: add: the new branch as a bullet list, 2 spaces per level

name.description: attr: the attribute's name, e.g. "Estimate". season: the running sprint's name, e.g. "Sprint 7" (optional). add_image, label: the image's name (add_image defaults to the file's name) — sending the same name twice never makes a duplicate. add_shape: optional, what makes re-sending it safe when x and y are auto

note.description: note: the note body (empty string clears it)

op.description: On a BOARD only: add_image, add_shape, add_text, resize, label, arrange — and move / delete with an element id as target (see the tool description). On a mind map or kanban: columns = set the kanban columns (give `columns`; no target) — on a map with no kanban yet this creates the board; format = set the map's living format (give `format`; no target) — "projet" turns it into a 🗂 project, "" back to a plain mind map; season = set the RUNNING sprint's goal (give `goal`, optionally `name` = the sprint's name; no target) — the goal the 🎯 chip and the 🏁 panel show, kept until the user closes the sprint; applied by itself when nobody typed one, otherwise sent for review; add = new children under `target`; rename = change its text; note = set its note; check = tick/untick the task; delete = remove it and its children; move = send the card to a kanban column (never to Done on a board that has a review column such as “🛂 To validate” — put the card there and a human moves it on; never to Won or Lost on a sales pipeline); pic = put an illustration on it; img = put a SCREENSHOT on it (give `file`, the path of the image on this machine — or `data`; `img: ""` removes it); persona = re-cast a work map canvas (a board whose name starts with “Work map —” / “Cartographie —”) or a Second Brain Blueprint (“Second brain —”) from an interview — no target; tags = set the card's colour labels; assign = who the task is for; priority = 1 (highest) to 6; due = the due day; attr = set a “Name: value” attribute on the node (an estimate, a budget…); comment = add a signed comment to the card's thread (give `text`); est = set the time ESTIMATE of the task (give `est`, e.g. "2h", "45" = 45 minutes, "" removes it); place = put a kanban card on the free board (give `x` and `y`, its top-left corner, whole numbers within ±50000) — a shape there named after a column, a day or a person is a ZONE and TabTree writes that field itself, so the move / assign / due the zone implies are added for you; start = the start day; lever = the card's Ai4X lever (give `lever`); link = put a link on the node (give `link`); star = put a ⭐ on the card for the user — a personal bookmark that shows on the card and in their ✅ My work, applied by itself (`value: false` removes it)

persona.description: persona: the interview object exactly as the skill returns it — who, role, mission, tools, meetings, opener, modules[{name, procs[{name,h,after,freq,rep,data,stakes,lever,step,why}]}], trajectory, signs, parking. TabTree rebuilds the canvas AND its companion sheet from it.

pic.description: pic: "a:<id>" for a built-in illustration, or "e:<emoji>" for one large emoji, or "" to remove it. Ids: person, team, chat, idea, target, trophy, star, heart, warning, done, flag, clock, laptop, phone, mail, folder, book, chart, money, calendar, building, car, globe, rocket, house, pin, plane, coffee, plant, sun, camera, music, lock, key, health, gift.

priority.description: priority: 1 (highest) to 6, or 0 to remove it

row.description: add_image with inside: optional grid row, from 0 — counted below what the shape already holds. Give row and col to every image of that shape, or to none

size.description: add_shape, add_text: the text size in px, 9..72

start.description: start: the start day as YYYY-MM-DD ("" removes it)

tags.description: tags: the colour labels to set, from: green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue, sky, lime, pink, gray — read_map shows the name the board gave each colour. [] clears them.

target.description: Exact node text, or "Ancestor > Node" if ambiguous (not used by persona). On a board: an element id from read_map (sh:2, im:7, st:0) or the exact name of an image

text.description: rename: the new text. comment: the comment body (plain text; http/mailto links become clickable). add_shape, add_text: its text

type.description: add_shape: rect (default), ellipse, diamond, trap, chev, arc, text or sticky

url.description: add_image: the https:// address of the image itself on a public website, instead of `file` — the connector downloads it (15 MB max, never a local address). Its name defaults to the last part of the address. Credit the author on the board when the licence asks for that.

value.description: check: true to tick, false to untick. star: false to remove the star (true by default). attr: its value as text, e.g. "2h" ("" removes the attribute)

w.description: add_image, add_shape, add_text, resize, arrange: the width. With inside or arrange, w and h form the cell the image is fitted into — use the same values to give every logo the same size

why.description: Any change: optional — one short line saying WHY (e.g. "Owns the website"). Shown to the user next to the change, so they can judge it

x.description: add_image, add_shape, add_text, move: the left edge on the board. place: the card's left edge

y.description: add_image, add_shape, add_text, move: the top edge on the board. place: the card's top edge

file.description: The map to change — a file name (or map name) from list_maps

note.description: One line telling the user what this proposal does and why. Shown above the changes.

name: propose_changes
title: Change a map (safe changes apply, others wait for review)
